programme.title: Overcoming Time of Patience: Selecting Hairs
programme.desc: In the traditional brush-making process, the process of selecting hairs, known as 'Jeongmo work,' is essential for creating a quality brush. Let's appreciate the artisan enduring the time of patience through thousands of repetitions. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Hometown of Custom Brassware: Brassware Master
programme.desc: A brassware master is an artisan with the skill of making various utensils from brass. We look into the work of a brassware master skilled in the technique of casting brassware. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Magic of Making Paper that Lasts a Thousand Years: Making Hanji
programme.desc: The process of making Hanji involves cutting, steaming, boiling, drying, peeling, re-boiling, pounding, mixing, scooping, and drying mulberry trees, undergoing 99 meticulous touches. Explore the dedicated process of 'Hanji making'. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Traditional Winter Tea Table: Royal Confectionery Winter Table
programme.desc: Sit in the warm ondol room with thick rice cakes (Duteopddeok) and sweet Gaeseong Yakgwa, and enjoy a warm cup of Sujeonggwa. Feel the warmth of winter. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Coloring with Lacquer: Color Lacquer Painting Master
programme.desc: Natural pigments layered over lacquer create vivid colors that endure for generations. Each stroke, dried and painted again with care, reveals the quiet precision and artistry of Korea’s traditional lacquer painting. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Listening to the Mountain Temple: Haenam Daeheungsa
programme.desc: Daeheungsa is located in Duryunsan Provincial Park, a famous mountain in Haenam, with traces of famous monks. Feel the serene scenery and sounds of the temple. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Autumn Forest of the Royal Tombs: With King Sejo's Regret, Gwangneung
programme.desc: The resting place of King Sejo and Queen Jeonghui, Gwangneung Forest in Namyangju covers an expansive area of 11 square kilometers, boasting ecological stability and species diversity. Enjoy a walk through its scenic forest paths. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Mystical Hidden Scenery: Jusanji Pond, Cheongsong EP.1
programme.desc: Completed in 1720, Jusanji Pond is fed by clear waters from Byeolbawi Rock and surrounded by lush forests of Juwangsan Mountain, creating a serene, otherworldly atmosphere. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Peaceful Mudflats: The Vast Mudflats at Sunset, Suncheon Bay
programme.desc: Located on the southern coast, Suncheon Bay features stunning reed fields and Salicornia (glasswort) colonies. It is home to diverse tidal flat creatures and rare birds like the black-faced spoonbill. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Continuing Tradition and Taste: Making Jang
programme.desc: Korean ancestors believed that the taste of Korean food is determined by the quality of Jang (fermented sauces), and without good Jang, there can’t be good food. Experience the deep taste through traditional Jang making. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Hand Skills of Joseon Artisans: Hat Making Master
programme.desc: The tanggeon, a horsehair hat once worn under the gat, reflected dignity in the daily lives of Joseon men. Densely woven by skilled hands, it reveals the calm elegance and restraint found in traditional craftsmanship. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: 傲慢と偏見、21回 21話
programme.desc: ドンチとムン部長はチェ検事を起訴するが、パク･マングンの正体を証言するはずの女は恐怖のあまり法廷で嘘をついてしまう。検察を辞めてチェ検事の弁護を引き受けたオ元次長は理路整然とチェ検事の無実を主張し、パク･マングンの正体は闇に葬られようとしていた。そんな中、証言席にパク･マングンの罪を被り収監中のイ元検察局長が現れ…。

programme.title: 傲慢と偏見、1回 1話
programme.desc: 検事見習いのヨルムは、研修に訪れた仁川地方検察庁でかつて恋仲だった首席検事のドンチと再会する。喜ぶドンチに対しヨルムは苦々しい表情を見せるが、“民生安定チーム”に配属されたヨルムの指導をドンチが担当することになる。配属早々、露出魔の迷惑行為事件を任されたヨルムは、事件の裏に児童虐待の闇が潜んでいることに気づき…。

programme.title: 傲慢と偏見、2回 2話
programme.desc: ５年前、路上で母親と揉めていたヨルムをドンチはひょんなことから車に乗せることになる。心の傷を隠すように明るい笑顔を見せるヨルムにドンチは一瞬で心を惹かれる。ドンチの誘いでデートを重ねた２人だったが、ある日、ヨルムはドンチの荷物の中から自分の弟を殺した犯人しか持ち得ない成績表の切れ端を見つけてしまう。ドンチが弟を殺したと確信したヨルムはこつ然と姿を消し…。

programme.title: 傲慢と偏見、3回 3話
programme.desc: ヨルムの活躍で麻薬の売人を逮捕した“民生安定チーム”だが、麻薬捜査に着手したいムン部長の思惑は、検察局長ら上層部の反対で頓挫してしまう。そんな中、保育園で階段から転落死した子供の事件を担当することになったヨルム。ムン部長はヨルムに事件を不起訴処理するよう命ずるが、納得のいかないヨルムは…。

programme.title: 傲慢と偏見、4回 4話
programme.desc: ムン部長は自分に従わないヨルムに冷や飯を食わせようとするが、事件の資料に不可解な点を見つけ、不起訴処理をひとまず保留にする。ヨルムは保育園の園長の供述に穴を見つけることができず、結局は不起訴処理が妥当だったと考え肩を落とすが、保育園の前に設置された防犯カメラの映像の中に、転落死した子供が生前、手話で助けを求める姿が残っていた。
